184-4682-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-4682-7824.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-7824.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

997-7084-8232.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

3184-3967-4766--190.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Yahenni trigger.
Repeat.

2438-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

533-6753-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-6753-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4017-4186-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

465-670-1619-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6152.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Veteran Dungeoneer from exile to the battlefield.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

803-3015-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Rhonas.
As God-Eternal Rhonas is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, it triggers, doubling the power of other creatures you control until end of turn.
Repeat.

2646-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

969-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2104-4477-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and exiling Ephemerate.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4613-5310-5477-5627-6633.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6633.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

240-2921-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

3621-3967-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3621-3967-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6835-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

343-2366-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

328-2173-5220-5686.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-5220-5686.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

5256-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

270-1395-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-4853-5256.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

934-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4508-4875-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-4875-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-4068-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

145-193-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
145-193-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Serra's Sanctum.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
145-193-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

1339-2034-2122-2265.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-2265.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1718-2646-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-2646-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2499-2608-4605.notablePrerequisites: You control up to six permanents that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
2499-2608-4605.description:
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger twice.
Resolve both Derevi triggers, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the second Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put either Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put the remaining Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

428-804-1694-2736.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-804-1694-2736.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

2092-2416-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-2416-4131.description:
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {1}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become a 0/0 artifact creature, then putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-2176-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Kabira Crossroads from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Kabira Crossroads, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Kabira Crossroads trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor

624-1558-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3480-3952-4893-5231.description:
Activate Purphoros by paying {R}, putting Firestorm Phoenix onto the battlefield from your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Firestorm Phoenix, adding {R}.
Firestorm Phoenix is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard.
Repeat.

2034-3843-4805-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Primeval Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
When Primeval Spawn dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Primeval Spawn on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Primeval Spawn trigger, exiling the top ten cards of your library, and casting Primeval Spawn by paying a total of {1} due to Chorus of the Conclave.
Repeat.

905-2178-2887.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scuttlemutt.
Scuttlemutt does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-2887.description:
Activate Scuttlemutt's second ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Scuttlemutt triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

618-864-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness with haste.
The token copy of Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

427-725-2477-5115.notablePrerequisites:
You have drawn at least 6 cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion attached to Kydele.
427-725-2477-5115.description:
Tap Kydele for {6}.
Pay {2} to Gemstone Array to put a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Remove the counter to add {W}.
Pay {3}{W} to Prava to create a 1/1 Soldier token.
Pay {1} and tap the Soldier token to untap Kydele with Aura of Dominion.
Repeat.

1173-2160-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Final Fortune, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat.
